workflow.heading: How the missed-call workflow works
workflow.subheading: MagicHango replies fast, collects the right details, and helps you approve bookings that fit the day.

steps.title: A client calls while you are grooming
steps.description: You stay focused on the dog in front of you instead of dropping everything to answer.

steps.title: MagicHango follows up by SMS
steps.description: The missed caller gets a quick text instead of waiting hours for a callback.

steps.title: The client shares the useful details
steps.description: Pet, breed, size, service, address, and preferences are collected in one place.

steps.title: You approve route-friendly options
steps.description: MagicHango suggests time slots that fit your route, and you validate before confirmation.

bottom.pitchLine3: Keep control of the final booking.
